fields.title: 📖 This knowledge is Dīn
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Sīrīn** said:

> ***“This knowledge is Dīn, so look from whom you take your Dīn.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever wants to protect his Dīn does not take knowledge from every speaker, but examines the **source**, the **Manhaj** and the **attribution**.

immutable.source: 📝 Muslim, Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Muqaddimah, Bāb: al-Isnād min ad-Dīn; überliefert von Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn.
